theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → R.Represents T → ∃ (T' : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents T' ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient ∧ R'.measure = R.measure.restrict E ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ E → T' ω = T ω) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) E → T' ω = 0
